66: Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček accepted an invitation from the Sokol members of Moravany near Pardubice to their traditional ball. The dance floor was extra slippery, but luckily we got through without a crash. A great crowd full of athletes, a caring organiser and a good mood gave the exhibition just the right dynamics. We rode the obstacles, a competition and jumps over volunteers. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you in the summer.
67: EP1 gallery exhibition – cycling art show – Trutnov
68: Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský accepted an invitation to perform at the opening of an exhibition of cycling-related art. We set up our trailer with the main obstacles at the main entrance and threw ourselves into our show. It was great to meet several former Trial riders and bikers there, who motivated us to perform even better. The exhibition was also very interesting and creative, as were the gallery spaces themselves, which we definitely recommend visiting.
69: Exhibitions in Zdíkov, Jiříkovice, Kovanice and Kolovraty
70: A series of exhibitions at children's days is almost a tradition at the start of the season. Matouš Balík and Michal Budský headed to Jiříkovice near Brno. Vlasta and Lukáš Valný went towards 'Sun, Hay, Strawberries' country (hopefully everyone gets it), where the event took place in the local gym because of the weather. From there they moved a few hundred kilometres to Kovanice north of Prague, where the spectators were already in full swing, and with reinforcement Tobík Dolák they rode a show by the local playground.
71: The next day a bigger children's day took place in the nearby Prague district of Kolovraty, where together with our Kabeláč kids' squad, Martínek Gomboš and of course Tobík Dolák we completed a rainy marathon of alternating showers and sunshine. Fortunately at least part of the exhibition stayed dry and everyone survived in good health – except for Vlasta's throat, as he hosted without a microphone :)
72: Half of the July events are behind us
74: A beautiful day, a big event and female company too. The ideal weekend exhibition right in the centre of Mariánské Lázně at Movomal 2021, the first event held after Covid-19. Lukáš Valný came along with Vlasta, and in two shows on our trailer they showed a few hundred spectators what can be done on a bike. The organisers praised us, and the spectators' reactions made it clear they were enjoying the day and the show. The only pity was that we couldn't stay for the afternoon too, but the wedding of Petr Jeřicha from our team and club simply took priority.
75: {1}12–16/7 – Organising a bike day camp – Tehov{2}
76: The second edition of our bike day camps, created under the banner of our club and the Bikeskills.cz project, will run in two sessions this time. The first July session is behind us, again with plenty of bike-hungry girls and boys who did nothing all day but fly around on bikes on the jumps, the pump track or on rides around the area. The rain complicated things a bit, but in the end it didn't turn out badly and the rain always stopped within a few hours. We also had alternative food in the form of flavoured gummy worms, and there were chess tournaments too.
77: {1}17/7 – Dolánky festival exhibition – Dolánky near Turnov{2}{3}{4}
78: We always look forward to a show with our legendary member Martin Šimůnek. The line-up was strong, we brought two trailers of obstacles and prepared a workshop. In the end it rained so much that we didn't even get the bikes out of the car, and we were glad the organiser let us go home, because the whole Liberec region was completely under water. It was probably the first exhibition where we didn't ride at all because of rain :( Hopefully we'll get a chance to show what we can do in slightly better conditions.
80: After his vaccination, but with the prospect of testing the Jahodnice bike park, Vlasta headed to the open days of Levelsportkoncept, which he has been working with for… well, a long time. The importer of POC, MALOJA, Lezyne, DVO and many other exclusive brands invites its employees and partners to a reception. Unfortunately Vlasta only had time for one day, so a test of Jahodnice was arranged, which was built by Michal Maroši, another LSK rider. There was playing around on the skills centre, the pump track was tested and a few attempts on the jumps too. Thanks for the invitation – we look forward to the next ride.
81: Two teams and two events – Zádveřice and Milíkov
82: On Saturday we had to split our team into two separate units. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš Balík headed to Milíkov to ride an exhibition and run a small workshop for the kids.
83: Vlasta, Marek Tryner and Katarína Tóthová, on the other hand, headed to Zádveřice, which was really packed with spectators and side programme. An accident on the motorway caused a delay, but the organiser forgave us and the guys did a solid job. They even earned a parcel of frgál cakes and refreshments for the workshop, which took place on the local asphalt pump track and jumps under Katarína's guidance.
85: The Tehov park hosted another day camp organised by Bikeskills and the MTB Trial Mraveniště club. The organising team has been stable for a few years now and instructors Katarína and Matěj know their job. Carers Lucka and Lenka fill the free time and treat any injuries that turn up.
86: This year a decent bunch of young guns of both sexes came together. The progress was really noticeable – unfortunately at the cost of two injuries (a split eyebrow and a concussion), which is part of riding bikes. Fortunately everything ended well with no lasting consequences. The weather was ideal and the kids managed everything physically too. Vlasta organised a small training session for the Trial riders taking part and, the next day, a somewhat more extreme ride for the older boys.
87: Photo shoot and exhibitions on a rainy weekend
88: We are currently processing photos from the shoot of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's new bike, taken by Říčany photo legend Ruda Flachs. In dust, sweat and mosquitoes they completed a shoot that will gradually be posted on social media.
89: For our team the weekend was all about exhibitions and holidays. Martin Šimůnek was performing in Hradec Králové and Vlasta with Lukáš Valný in Rumburk. Both days it was absolutely pouring…, but huge respect to the organisers who carried on, and all the events went ahead. Sometimes you just have to ride in the wet.
90: We have a few photos in the gallery, but nothing to write home about.
91: We opened the pump track in Brandýs
92: Our projects Trialshow.cz and Bikeskills.cz were invited to the opening of a luxury pump track in Brandýs.
93: The main part of the programme was an exhibition by our team – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík – with guest Ondra Nenadál from our club.
94: The workshop with coaching for kids and adults was run by Katarína Tóthová with the family teams of the Hlouchas and Kabeláčs and all the riders from our club who had a moment to come, cheer and ride.
95: A nice turnout of spectators filled the pump track and the space around the obstacles. Everyone rode like their lives depended on it, and it was great to see kids and parents enjoying testing the pump track as well as our exhibition.
96: E*thirteen is now available from us
97: E*thirteen is a world leader in products focused on mountain bike chain retention. Besides chain guides, its range also includes wheels, hubs, seatposts, cassettes, chainrings and much more.
98: Our riders currently use their cranks, wheels, tyres, tubeless kits and pedals.
99: Find out more on the {1}{2}manufacturer's{3}{4} website, or jump straight to our {5}{6}e-shop{7}{8}. To start with, we have a 10% discount (or on request) for all enthusiasts who want to pimp their bike.
100: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague ball
101: A 'small' ball with 2,000 guests was organised by students of the Czech University of Life Sciences (CZU) in Prague.
102: They thought they'd like something a bit edgier and called our team to come along. Vlasta and Luky packed the obstacles and launched a show in the main hall for a great audience. Admittedly, volunteers were hard to find given the formal dress, but a few brave souls came forward. Luky had a few technical problems, but everything was handled and the exhibition went as it should. Thanks to the organisers for the invitation and the hospitality.
103: Sokol exhibition, Saints Cyril and Methodius Day, Radonice village festival, day camp, …
104: July is slowly coming to an end and we have a lot of work behind us. Besides lots of group and individual lessons, we also had our traditional week-long day camp. Once again it was fully booked, and this time it attracted practically only boys and girls who can already do something on a bike and want to move forward. It's great that they keep coming back to us over the years. Just before the camp we had an exhibition marathon: Dolní Kalná (exhibition for Sokol), Oucmanice (Saints Cyril and Methodius Day) and Radonice near Kadaň (village festival), where a pretty decent number of spectators gathered. Almost the whole team took part in the shows – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Martin Šimůnek, Marek Tryner, Lukáš Valný and Michal Budský. During the month Vlasta also popped over to the Slovak Cup to act as a riding coach for the club kids at a successful local event in Veľké Zálužie, and filmed a short e-bike video with Katarína Tóthová. Individual E-MTB courses have also taken off, and it's great that whole groups of friends come together whom we can take around the area.
105: Next month we have one or more exhibitions every weekend, so hopefully the weather holds and we'll see you there.
107: On Mother's Day we organised a Mix camp for everyone interested in technique. The weather worked out, so a group of male and female bikers could take on both our coaching and everything we put in their way. This time Katarína Tóthová and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček chose easier locations that could suit all riders. We managed to cover the basics as well as a few more advanced techniques. We were a little surprised by our afternoon return to the Tehov leisure park, which was packed – finding a free spot on the pump track was really hard.
108: For Vlasta it was also his first camp on the CUBE e-bike he was issued, and since one of the participants was riding electric too, it came in handy as a demonstration of everything you can do on an e-bike.
110: We have our first two Bikeskills camps behind us, held over the weekend in Tehov and the surrounding area. Attendance was affected by lots of cancellations due to illness, which hit those around us too. We mostly covered the basics and fine-tuned body position, and the women rode the pump track a lot. The men's group focused more on drops and benches. The weather was kind to us and there were very few crashes. Hopefully our coaching will give riders more confidence for the coming season. Riders who cancelled were moved to further camps and individual coaching.
111: The magnificent seven across the country
112: We had plenty of work over the weekend. Part of the team led by Lukáš Valný headed to Moravia for a cycling day in Libhošť, where Matouš Balík, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš showed what they could at a smaller event for cycling enthusiasts. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Dalibor Šulc and Marty Kabeláč, meanwhile, were in Dolní Poustevna celebrating the Village of the Year, which was full of concerts and programmes for kids and adults. In two shows we presented a combination of a motorbike, a mountain bike, a smaller 24" bike and kids' Trial. Because of the space we used fewer obstacles, but it was still packed, the spectators cheered like crazy and egged us on to a few bigger jumps.
113: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills camp report
114: We've organised day camps and we train men, but women were somewhat missing from our portfolio. Together with Katarína Tóthová we prepared a camp exclusively for the fairer sex – though I'd probably start calling them something else. Although registration again opened only a few weeks in advance, 10 brave Amazons signed up who wanted to improve their riding technique, and even learn how to repair a bike.
115: The whole morning was devoted to basic technique, riding over sleepers, body position on the bike, the pump track (i.e. rollers and berms) and the trail in our park. Then we moved to the popular Říčany restaurant Na Jurečku to refuel and rehydrate. And after lunch it was straight out into the terrain for descents, roots and even a hint of dropping.
116: We have to take our hats off to everyone, because on the same terrain many men would at least hesitate or get off the bike. They simply went for it with heart and encouragement.  After returning to the park there was a final workshop by Mára Tryner focused on bike repair and maintenance, and a look at the MALOJA 2021 collection.
117: Thanks to everyone for taking part – we'll answer questions about the next date within a few days :)
119: After a year we once again held a bike day camp. Putting the team together took relatively long, but in the end we assembled a great group of bikers and leaders who prepared an interesting five days on the bike for more than 27 boys and girls. The weather was against us at first, but a proper biker rides in all weathers. Honza Havránek could tell you all about that as a downhiller. Michal Budský as a Trial rider would have a harder time, but he is a versatile rider with experience across several disciplines. The guys also had young guns Tobík and Dan, who helped with everything our capable leaders Lenka and Klárka needed. Vlasta was in charge of preparation, building, Trial training and a few other small things.
120: The riders were skilful and there wasn't a single one who didn't improve. A competition every day, the occasional small crash (luckily nothing serious) and enthusiasm for riding from all the boys and girls.
